title: Zelda is back and better than ever

claims.claim: Bambu Lab H3C 3D yazıcının fiyatı 2.500 dolardır.

evidence.quote: At $2,500, this one’s a little steep for my wallet, but I think my colleague Sean Hollister is right that this is what the future of 3D printing looks like.
The Bambu Lab H3C. I am dangerously close to becoming a 3D Printer Dude. At $2,500, this one’s a little steep for my wallet

claims.claim: Sony MDR-3R kulaklıkların satış fiyatı 60 dolardır.

evidence.quote: You’ll look a little like Nathan Fielder in You Can See Everything when you wear them, and $60 ain’t cheap, but there’s something so incredibly ’70s-era cool about them.

The Sony MDR-3R headphones. Respect to Sony for taking the retro headphone trend all the way to its logical conclusion and just releasing the headphones from the original Walkman. You’ll look a little like Nathan Fielder in You Can See Everything when you wear them, and $60 ain’t cheap

claims.claim: Tristan Homsi, Readwise şirketinin kurucu ortaklarından biridir.

evidence.quote: I’ve talked to Tristan Homsi, one of the Readwise cofounders, a few times over the years

claims.claim: Tristan Homsi, kişisel telefon olarak iPhone 13 kullanmaktadır.

evidence.quote: The phone: iPhone 13 (!).Believe it or not, I chose to buy this relatively outdated phone last year
I also am a huge fan of the somewhat-defunct social app BeReal. It had its moment in 2022, but quite a few of my friends are still on there!

claims.claim: Kagi arama motoru, kullanıcılarına ödeme yapmadan önce 50 ücretsiz arama hakkı sunmaktadır.
Kagi arama motorunun aylık abonelik ücreti 10 dolardır.
Tristan Homsi, günlük ulaşım aracı olarak San Francisco'da Bay Wheels kullanmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Bay Wheels is my main mode of commute around San Francisco daily.
Strava and Runmeter are awesome for tracking my runs… and Bay Wheels is my main mode of commute around San Francisco daily.
